content_sections.heading: AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the tenure of the posts.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi

Diagnostic Validity and User Preferences of Indigenous Point-of-Care Urinary HPV Testing versus Vaginal Self-Sampling for Cervical Cancer Screening Among Transgender Men in India: A Mixed-Methods Study (The HPV-EQUITY Study)
Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical), Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical), Project Nurse - III, Project Technical Support -1
Consolidated remuneration 67000, 56000, 28000 or 18000 plus HRA as admissible, by post

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi, and is signed by Dr. Seema Singhal, Professor and Project Investigator. The posts are filled on contract basis for the HPV-EQUITY Study, Project Code I-2060.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists four posts with one vacancy each, a total of 4. It prints no category-wise break-up. Age relaxation is as per AIIMS/ICMR rules. The notice prints no date as on which age is counted.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints no desirable qualification for any post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical): 40 years Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): 35 years Project Nurse - III: 35 years Project Technical Support -1: 28 years The notice says relaxation is as per AIIMS/ICMR rules and gives no category-wise figures.

rows.essential_qualification: 1. Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees, with three years post qualification Experience or PhD. 2. For Engineering / IT / CS - Graduate degree of Four Years with three years' post qualification experience.
1. Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees. 2. For Engineering / IT / CS - Four Years Graduate Degree.
10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT / ITI or equivalent) + two Years experience in relevant subject / field. Or Three years Graduate degree in relevant subject / field + one year experience in relevant subject.

content_sections.heading: Pay
content_sections.text: Each post carries a consolidated remuneration plus HRA as admissible: Project Research Scientist II 67000, Project Research Scientist I 56000, Project Nurse - III 28000 and Project Technical Support -1 18000. The notice also prints a line "$. As per ICMR rules" without showing which item it belongs to.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Google form given in the notice. Two form addresses are printed below the post table: https://forms.gle/XRZySeovrKmNEjku8 and https://forms.gle/4odzMVWFsx9b6Uxz9 . Fill in your brief information in the form. Submit the form by 5.30 pm on 17 December 2026. The notice says this information is required for the short listing of candidates. Watch your email for interview details, which are sent only to shortlisted candidates. The notice does not name documents to attach and does not say which of the two forms belongs to which post.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The information given in the Google form is used for short listing of candidates. The interview will be held in offline or online mode, and its details will be sent only to shortlisted candidates through email. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the AIIMS New Delhi project recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: one each for Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical), Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical), Project Nurse - III and Project Technical Support -1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The Google form must be filled by 5.30 pm on 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Nurse - III?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a Four-year Nursing Course for Project Nurse - III.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support -1?
faq.answer: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT / ITI or equivalent) + two years experience in relevant subject / field, or a three-year graduate degree in relevant subject / field + one year experience in relevant subject.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for each post?
faq.answer: The limit is 40 years for Project Research Scientist II, 35 years for Project Research Scientist I and Project Nurse - III, and 28 years for Project Technical Support -1. Relaxation is as per AIIMS/ICMR rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: Consolidated remuneration is 67000 for Project Research Scientist II, 56000 for Project Research Scientist I, 28000 for Project Nurse - III and 18000 for Project Technical Support -1, each plus HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice prints "+ HRA as admissible" against every post, in addition to the consolidated remuneration.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the Google form with brief information by 5.30 pm on 17 December 2026. The form addresses printed in the notice are https://forms.gle/XRZySeovrKmNEjku8 and https://forms.gle/4odzMVWFsx9b6Uxz9.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Google form information is used for short listing, followed by an interview in offline or online mode. Details are sent by email only to shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent posts?
faq.answer: No, the notice invites applications for these posts on contract basis in the HPV-EQUITY Study project.
